headline: UPDATE TO 0100-04 (toll revision surfaced in-window) -- Komyshuvakha aid-centre strike toll rises to 26 killed, ~20 missing

sources: Acting Zaporizhzhia regional governor + President Volodymyr Zelensky, reported by AFP
fault_line: Aid site as target: 26 dead at a school handing out aid, with rescue crews attacked as they dug -- deliberate strike on civilians, or the latest civilian toll of a bombing campaign both sides frame differently?

sections.what_happened: The toll from the Nov 2 morning Russian bomb strikes on Komyshuvakha (recorded at 0100-04 as 24 killed) has risen to at least 26 killed, per the acting regional governor via AFP; about 20 people are considered missing and the toll could rise further. Rescue efforts on the night of Nov 2 were hindered as Russian drones launched additional attacks on the bombed area (per Zaporizhzhia military official Mykhailo Semikin via Stuff). The same AFP report notes Russia resumed strikes on Kherson after the local ceasefire expired, and that both countries' emergency-warning apps were hacked overnight (Ukraine's app late Nov 1, Russia's app ~02:45 Moscow time Nov 2 across 33 regions). Production must use 26 (latest AFP figure), not 24, and must keep framing it as the Nov 2 morning strike, not overnight news.
sections.what_verified: Two declared-tier families: Ukraine government (Zelensky statement + acting governor toll, T1 STATE UA) and AFP wire (T1). Stuff relay is undeclared in the registry and is NOT counted.
sections.what_disputed: No Russian response or alternative account in the retrieved summary. The nine-bomb follow-up figure remains Zelensky's statement only. Timestamp ambiguity: FMT shows 05:18 (MYT = 01:18 ) which would be pre-window, but the 26 figure appears in no prior scan file and the kimkj briefing through 00:50 still carried 24 -- recorded here as an in-window update with that caveat.
sections.why_matters: The toll kept rising after dark: 26 dead now at the aid school, 20 more missing -- and drones attacked the rescuers digging through the rubble. The morning strike the day's coverage missed, updated.
sections.context: Background: UPDATE TO 0100-04 (toll revision surfaced in-window) -- Komyshuvakha aid-centre strike toll rises to 26 killed, ~20 missing; rescue hindered by follow-up drone attacks

totw_analysis: Our read: The toll kept rising after dark: 26 dead now at the aid school, 20 more missing -- and drones attacked the rescuers digging through the rubble. The morning strike the day's coverage missed, updated.
